# Nick Kontonicolaou — Astoria & Ditmars Real Estate

> Nick Kontonicolaou (legal name Nickolaos Kontonicolaou-Dits) is a licensed New York real estate salesperson with Modern Spaces. He focuses on Astoria and Ditmars in Queens, NY, and also works in Astoria Heights, Long Island City and Sunnyside. He helps renters, buyers, sellers and landlords.
